title: Compliance milestone synchronization hub and OKR decoupling playbook
creator: Priya Patel
description: Create a single operational hub and playbook that (1) synchronizes milestones across SOC2/ISO/SSO & audit-log initiatives, (2) decouples OKR tracking from sprint-level tasks, and (3) provides templated cutover/rollback procedures for tenant onboarding and audit evidence collection. This ticket defines the milestone schema, reporting cadence, handoff points between PM/Eng/Security, and automation hooks for evidence ingestion. Goal: reduce cross-team drift, surface gating risks early, and shorten external audit remediation windows.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone schema documented and agreed by PM/Eng/Security
Central milestone dashboard prototype reflecting live status for SOC2/ISO/SSO/audit-log
Automated alerts for gating thresholds (dependency lag > 5 days, evidence missing > 2 milestones)
Cutover playbook templates created for tenant-scoped auditlog retention and SSO/SAML provider migrations
OKR-level progress bar that decouples from engineering ticket velocity and maps to proof-of-evidence counters
milestones: Evidence mapping per control (SOC2/ISO) and per-customer template
Audit-log retention policy enforcement and verification harness
Dry run with internal tenant + incident simulation
External pre-audit checklist and remediation sprint
Production cutover and audit evidence handoff
timeline: MVP milestone hub by 2025-04-18 (Cycle 14), full evidence mapping and SSO staging by 2025-05-30, production cutover window June 2025. Weekly milestone sync on Fridays; gating review every other Tuesday.
risks: Mis-aligned evidence definitions between Security and Eng leads
Delayed SAML provider validation due to partner constraints
Audit log storage quota impacts Dedicated customers during dry runs
OKR progress incorrectly tied to ticket velocity causing stakeholder confusion
decisions: Adopt a 3-tier milestone severity model: blocker/high/low for gating
Use existing observability event stream (eng-telemetry) as single source of truth for audit evidence ingestion
Treat SSO cutovers as tenant-scoped feature flags with automatic rollback on failed auth-tests
